scope: Append-only decisions, controls, errors, and corrections for this task's GitHub archive maintenance boundary.

hash_contract.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; one compact JSON object plus LF per record
hash_contract.record_sha256: SHA-256 of the compact canonical JSON object in schema field order, excluding record_sha256 and excluding the terminal LF
hash_contract.chain: Each record after the first binds the preceding record_sha256 in prev_record_sha256
hash_contract.append: The helper takes an exclusive file lock, replays the entire chain, rejects duplicate IDs or unknown supersession IDs, then appends one record
